title: Chronic liver disease
summary: Chronic liver disease meeting one of: A hemorrhaging from varices/portal hypertensive gastropathy causing hemodynamic instability requiring transfusion of ≥2 units (12-month presumptive disability post-transfusion); B ascites or hydrothorax despite prescribed treatment on at least two evaluations ≥60 days apart within a consecutive 6-month period; C spontaneous bacterial peritonitis (ANC ≥250 cells/mm3); D hepatorenal syndrome with D.1 serum creatinine ≥2 mg/dL, D.2 oliguria (24h urine <500 mL), or D.3 sodium retention (urine sodium <10 mEq/L); E hepatopulmonary syndrome; F hepatic encephalopathy; or G end-stage liver disease with SSA CLD scores ≥22.

children.criterion: Hemorrhaging from esophageal, gastric, or ectopic varices or from portal hypertensive gastropathy, demonstrated by endoscopy, x-ray, or other appropriate medically acceptable imaging, resulting in hemodynamic instability as defined in 5.00D5, and requiring hospitalization for transfusion of at least 2 units of blood. Consider under a disability for 1 year following the last documented transfusion; thereafter, evaluate the residual impairment(s).

Ascites or hydrothorax not attributable to other causes, despite continuing treatment as prescribed, present on at least two evaluations at least 60 days apart within a consecutive 6-month period. Each evaluation must be documented by laboratory and clinical findings.
Spontaneous bacterial peritonitis with peritoneal fluid containing an absolute neutrophil count of at least 250 cells/mm3
Hepatorenal syndrome as described in 5.00D8, with one of D.1, D.2, or D.3
Serum creatinine elevation of at least 2 mg/dL
Oliguria with 24-hour urine output less than 500 mL
Sodium retention with urine sodium less than 10 mEq per liter
Hepatopulmonary syndrome as described in 5.00D9 (arterial hypoxemia with intrapulmonary vascular dilatations)
Hepatic encephalopathy as described in 5.00D10, with documented altered mental status, signs of asterixis or other neurologic findings, and either elevated ammonia or EEG abnormalities
End stage liver disease with SSA CLD scores of 22 or greater calculated as described in 5.00D11. Consider under a disability from at least the date of the first score.
